Taylor Nguyen: Hey team—new international contractor (Asha Rao) is starting Mon in our Singapore satellite office but needs a same-day notarized I-9 alternative and a temporary badge. Shes flagged as contractor but payroll says bank verification needed for honorarium. Any blockers?
Zara Patel: Welcome Asha! Quick Q: is she classified 1099 or contractor through our vendor? That changes the paperwork.
Chris O'Neill: She's onboarded via vendor pool (Contractor Ops) so 1099-style. Vendor docs were uploaded but banking proof is missing.
Riley Brooks: Facilities can do a one-time badge for day 1 if Security approves notarized docs via local notary. We need a scheduled time and scanned ID beforehand.
Taylor Nguyen: SG timezone morning works better for Asha. Can we do 9:30am local at SG office lobby? Onboard Bot can you create a notary exception ticket and send DocuSign?
Onboard Bot: Exception created: CASE-2026-573. DocuSign sent for "Notarized I-9 Alternative" and "Vendor Bank Attestation". ETA to Asha: 10m.
Zara Patel: Note: contractors don't enroll in benefits. Please mark benefits waiver signed in profile.
Chris O'Neill: Payroll needs a bank statement plus photo ID for vendor pay. Can Asha upload both to the vendor portal?
Taylor Nguyen: She said in her intake form she can meet at the lobby and has a scanned passport. I'll post a pre-signed visitor form link.
Riley Brooks: Security here: pls note SG lobby process requires 2 forms of ID for temporary badge. We'll accept passport + vendor portal upload screenshot. Badge expires EOD local time. Escort available: Mei.
Taylor Nguyen: Sending link: https://onboard.redwood/company/forms/visitor-pre-sign. Asha can sign and upload.
Onboard Bot: DocuSign status: completed for Notarized I-9 alt. Vendor Bank Attestation pending.
Chris O'Neill: Once bank attestation uploaded, payroll can issue honorarium. Tag payroll: @Payroll (manual).
Zara Patel: Also flag contractor onboarding checklist: tax form W-9 vs foreign form—visa status matters. Has Asha confirmed tax residency?
Taylor Nguyen: Asha is Singapore tax resident per intake. We'll attach the tax residency statement to her vendor record.
Riley Brooks: Facilities note: bring the confirmation code at pickup: REDWOOD-SG-349. We'll validate ID + pre-signed form and hand off badge.
Taylor Nguyen: Thanks! I'll coordinate with Asha and confirm 9:30am pickup. If notarized docs are needed physically, Mei can escort to the notary desk on-site.
Onboard Bot: CASE-2026-573 updated: badge window scheduled 09:30-10:30 SGT, escort assigned.
Taylor Nguyen: One last thing can someone confirm that contractor laptop is BYOD or if IT should provide a loaner? Asha requested a loaner.
Chris O'Neill: IT to provide loaner if vendor billing approved. I'll kick off IT ticket and cc Facilities.
Riley Brooks: All set on facilities side. Security will keep a log of the temporary badge pickup.
Taylor Nguyen: Great team, will post final confirmation once Asha uploads bank attestation. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :party_parrot:
